name: Fenland Paws
tagline: Happy dogs. Confident owners. Wisbech's friendliest dog training.
heroTitle: Bring out the best in your dog
heroText: Fun, reward-based training classes in Wisbech for puppies, adolescents and grown-up dogs. Small groups, big results, lots of treats.

trainerBio: Sam has been training dogs across the Fens for over twelve years and is a fully accredited, force-free trainer. When not in the training barn, Sam is usually being out-run by two spaniels along the Nene.

faqs.q: What age can my puppy start?
faqs.a: Puppies can join Puppy Foundations from 8 weeks, as long as they've had their first vaccination. The earlier the better — the socialisation window closes fast!

faqs.q: Do you use punishment or 'dominance' methods?
faqs.a: Never. Everything we do is reward-based and science-led. Dogs learn fastest when training is fun, and we're proud members of the force-free community.

faqs.q: My dog is reactive to other dogs. Can they come to a class?
faqs.a: Group classes can be too much for a reactive dog. Book a 1-2-1 Behaviour session first and we'll build a plan — many of our 1-2-1 dogs go on to join a class later.
Lots of tiny, tasty treats (cheese and chicken are winners), a flat collar or harness, a normal lead (no extendables), and your dog's favourite toy. Water bowls are provided.
In our covered, fully-fenced barn on Leverington Road on the edge of Wisbech, with plenty of free parking. Agility runs on the paddock next door when it's dry.

faqs.q: What if I miss a week?
faqs.a: Life happens! Each course includes one free catch-up session and you'll get the week's notes and homework by email so you don't fall behind.
